A '''computer tool kit''' was a tool kit intended to help an individual to perform repairs on [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. They were readily available for sale throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and generally cost 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.<ref name="SWS" />
